status_definitions.LIVE_VERIFIED: At least one real user/GitHub/Termux observation for the scoped claim
status_definitions.SOURCE_TESTED: Implementation + focused offline tests; not necessarily live acceptance
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Implemented or observed only for a subset; acceptance outstanding
status_definitions.OPEN: Original feature not implemented/connected as promised
status_definitions.EXCLUDED: User-excluded paid GitHub private protected-CI gate; never claim PASS
